prerequisites: Partial differential equations and differential operators

learning_outcomes.text: Calculate pressure forces due to fluids.
Understand and interpret phenomena related to fluid flow.
Understand and interpret phenomena related to the action of fluids on objects.
Choose suitable hydraulic machines for some industrial configurations.

syllabus_topics: Fluid properties and essential mathematical tools
Fluid statics. Laws of hydrostatics and associated hydrostatic forces
Dynamics of incompressible perfect fluids. Bernoulli's equation and applications
Dynamics of viscous fluids. Navier-Stokes equations. Similarities. Laminar and turbulent regimes. Notion of boundary layer
Pressurized flows. Pipe flows. Generalized Bernoulli, Head losses. Networks
bibliography: F. White, Fluid Mechanics, Ed. McGraw-Hill
B. R. Munson, D. F. Young, T. H. Okiishi, Fundamentals of fluid mechanics, Ed. Wiley
Y. A. Çengel, J. M. Cimbala, Fluid mechanics: fundamentals and applications, Ed. McGraw-Hill
S. Candel, Problèmes résolus de mécanique des fluides, Ed. Dunod
D. Desjardins, M. Combarnous, N. Bonneton, Problèmes résolus avec rappels de cours, Ed. Dunod
S. Amiroudine, J.-L. Battaglia, Mécanique des fluides – Cours et exercices corrigés, Ed. Dunod
B. Comolet, J. Bonnin, Mécanique expérimentale des fluides – Recueil d’exercices, Ed. Masson
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
